constraints.text: Two-stage presence protocol. (1) FIRST declare diagramCompleteness for start/end events based on the image: 'present', 'absent_ellipsis' (diagram visibly ends with an ellipsis / '...' / trailing dots), or 'absent_unclear'. (2) ONLY events declared 'present' may appear in elements[]. An event absent from elements[] is NOT an error when diagramCompleteness declares it absent; fabricating an event declared absent IS an error (hallucination).
If the event has a specific type (Message, Timer, Error, etc.), it must be indicated via eventType or name.
The Message flow is represented by a dashed line, with a HOLLOW/SMALL CIRCLE marker at the source (origin) side and an OPEN arrowhead at the target side.
Association is represented by a dotted or dash-dotted line. If a directional marker exists it is an OPEN (hollow) arrowhead; if no marker exists the Association is undirected.
The branch in the parallel gateway has no conditional attributes.
The branch in the exclusive gateways may contain conditional attributes, but their presence is not mandatory.
The branches created by a parallel gateway are generally synchronized through the corresponding parallel gateways.
Sequence flow is used within the same Pool (possibly across Lanes) to connect activities, events, and gateways.
Message flow must connect different Pools for asynchronous communication. A MessageFlow connecting elements within the same Pool, including different Lanes of that Pool, is an error.
The starting/ending points of the message flow may be on Pool boundaries or specific element boundaries.
ObjectN keys in elements[] must be unique, start at Object1 and be gap-free sequential. Duplicates or gaps → needs_revision.

Connection reference consistency: if a connection element provides both sourceRef/targetRef AND incoming/outgoing arrays they must be exactly equal after unwrapping (scalar vs. single-item). Any mismatch → needs_revision. Arrays of length > 1 in endpoint references → needs_revision (multi-reference is an error).

parent/contains consistency. For every Lane with parent=ObjectP, ObjectP.contains MUST include this Lane. For every entry A in Container.contains, A.parent (if present on A) must equal Container or a transitive direct container; direct children only in contains (no grandchildren) → otherwise needs_revision.
Required shape fields. Pool/Lane/Event/Activity/Gateway/DataObject must carry x/y/width/height integers. Missing → needs_revision.
Required connection fields. SequenceFlow/MessageFlow/Association must have start{x,y} and end{x,y} plus at least one endpoint reference style. Missing → needs_revision.

Connectivity invariant. Every Activity and Gateway must have >=1 incoming and >=1 outgoing SequenceFlow. A StartEvent must have no incoming; an EndEvent must have no outgoing. Any violation is a hard error (executed by code in topology_checks.py, not by judgement).

Supporting-element anchoring invariant. Every DataObject/DataStore/TextAnnotation must be anchored by >=1 Association or appear in some activity's dataInputAssociation/dataOutputAssociation. An unanchored artifact is a hard error. Association endpoints must be (artifact, flow node); MessageFlow endpoints must be in different Pools.

DI consistency invariant. Every shape-like element in the semantic layer must have a BPMNShape with Bounds, and every SequenceFlow/MessageFlow/Association must have a BPMNEdge with >=2 waypoints. Checked by code after generation.

synthetic_rules._comment: Synthetic error entries injected by deterministic code (not by the reviewer). Downstream Modify Agent must treat them as ordinary errors.

constraints.text: Inventory discrepancy: the surveyor counted more instances of this class than were extracted. Re-scan the region or add the missing element.
Connectivity defect: a node has a missing incoming/outgoing flow. Only add a flow when the cropped evidence shows a directed line.
Render-back difference: a shape/line visible in the original is missing (or extra) in the rendered reconstruction.
